_comment: DAY-STATE gate, SPENT branch only, calibrated specifically for UGLD (ЮГК). FreshDayATR=0 is the off switch for the early-entry branch: dayStateOK guards it with `fresh > 0 &&`, so exactly 0 removes it entirely — a small positive value like 0.01 does NOT, it still admits a day whose range has barely opened. What is left is one strategy instead of two: buy the RSI pullback only after the day has already spent at least SpentDayATR of its daily ATR. The axis reaches down to 0.4 and stops at 1.5 because of UGLD's own session-range distribution (range/dailyATR: p10 0.22, p25 0.43, median 0.67, p75 1.25, p90 1.69) — 0.4 sits at the first quartile, 1.5 already near the top decile, and anything beyond it would gate on days too rare to rank. 7 evaluations. Compare the winner's profit factor against ugld/cal_day.json (both branches) and against a fresh-only run (SpentDayATR far above any reachable range, e.g. 99): a two-branch profit factor averages two different trades together and can hide that one branch pays for the other. Caveat: the gate lets the entry through when TodayHigh/TodayLow are missing, so a data hole reads as 'allowed', not as 'spent'. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker UGLD -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/ugld/cal_day_spent.json -out ./reports/UGLD_day_spent -months 24 -min-trades 20 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor.
